style.name: Corporate Modernism
style.description: Style Atlas daily pick: Corporate Modernism. Use premium international corporate editorial design with rigorous typography, modular geometry, restrained navy, cobalt, warm white and signal-red accents, strong information hierarchy and precise data graphics. Keep mobile readability first: one main conclusion and no more than three key facts per poster, 3-5 clear modules, large text, generous spacing and calm low-texture text zones. Content, data, scenes and infographics occupy at least 70%; Xiazi and Doudou together stay around 10-15% at edges or the bottom. NO.01 is the exception: preserve all eight numbered one-sentence summaries exactly, with a central globe or global operations scene and eight uneven flowing bands, arcs or layered story paths around it. Give every sentence a broad quiet high-contrast reading zone; never use a rigid grid, table, equal cards, dense borders or tiny type. Chinese and English must keep the same composition, scene and rhythm.

zh-CN.headlineView: 物流成本、AI治理、创业杠杆与公共风险同时重排
zh-CN.headlineFull: 9月18日全球经营雷达；物流成本、AI治理、创业杠杆与公共风险同时重排
zh-CN.intro:
1. 马士基停止远东至北欧和地中海拼箱航线的旺季附加费，为跨境卖家释放一项即时物流成本变化。
2. OpenAI建立模型失配事件披露框架，并首次公开过去半年观察到的六类异常行为。
3. FreshBooks调查显示86%的独立创业者遇到能力缺口时会先尝试AI再考虑雇人。
4. 瑞典中左翼阵营以176席赢得最终计票，首相克里斯特松宣布辞职。
5. 斐济宣布HIV国家紧急状态，并扩大检测、治疗和减害措施。
6. WMO报告称2025年全球河流经历35年来最干旱年份之一，陆地淡水储量继续下降。
7. 联合国报告称三分之一的性别平等机构在两年内被削权，全球女性仅占企业CEO的6%。
8. 美国连续第二年拒绝巴勒斯坦高级代表团赴联合国大会的签证，但驻纽约外交官仍可参会。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 今天的共同信号是：成本、权限和公共系统都需要更明确的责任边界。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先找到哪一条会在本周改变你的报价、授权或风险清单。

en-US.headlineView: Logistics costs, AI governance, founder leverage and public risks are being reordered together
en-US.headlineFull: September 18 Global Operator Radar; Logistics costs, AI governance, founder leverage and public risks are being reordered together
en-US.intro:
1. Maersk ends the peak-season surcharge on less-than-container-load routes from Far East Asia to Northern and Mediterranean Europe, changing an immediate logistics cost for cross-border sellers.
2. OpenAI creates a model-misalignment disclosure framework and publishes six categories of unexpected behavior observed over the past six months.
3. A FreshBooks survey finds that 86% of solopreneurs try AI before hiring when they face a task they cannot complete alone.
4. Sweden's center-left bloc wins the final count with 176 seats, prompting Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson to resign.
5. Fiji declares a national HIV emergency and expands testing, treatment and harm-reduction measures.
6. WMO says 2025 was one of the driest years for global rivers in 35 years as terrestrial freshwater storage kept declining.
7. A UN report says one in three gender-equality institutions lost power in two years while women hold only 6% of corporate CEO roles globally.
8. The United States denies visas to a senior Palestinian delegation for the UN General Assembly for a second year, while accredited New York diplomats may still attend.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Today's shared signal is that costs, permissions and public systems all need clearer boundaries of responsibility.
en-US.doudouQuote: Identify which change will alter your pricing, authorization or risk list this week.

sources.title: Stoppage of LCL Peak Season Surcharge from Far East Asia to North Europe and Mediterranean

zh-CN.headlineFact: 远东至欧洲拼箱旺季附加费停止
zh-CN.headlineView: 一项即时报价变量消失，但卖家仍要重新核算完整落地成本
zh-CN.headlineFull: 远东至欧洲拼箱旺季附加费停止；一项即时报价变量消失，但卖家仍要重新核算完整落地成本
zh-CN.intro: 马士基宣布，自2026年9月17日计价日起，远东亚洲发往北欧和地中海的拼箱货物不再收取旺季附加费。覆盖中国、日本、韩国和东南亚等起运地；跨境卖家应向货代索取更新后的价盘，并把省下的费用与关税、目的港和末端派送成本一起重算。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 附加费取消不是利润自动增加，关键是新版报价能否传导到每个SKU。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 今天就让货代重发价盘，并对比三条线路的完整落地成本。

en-US.headlineFact: Far East-Europe LCL peak-season surcharge ends
en-US.headlineView: One immediate quote variable disappears, but sellers still need a full landed-cost reset
en-US.headlineFull: Far East-Europe LCL peak-season surcharge ends; One immediate quote variable disappears, but sellers still need a full landed-cost reset
en-US.intro: Maersk says the peak-season surcharge will no longer apply to less-than-container-load cargo from Far East Asia to Northern and Mediterranean Europe from the September 17, 2026 price calculation date. Origins include China, Japan, South Korea and Southeast Asia. Sellers should request updated forwarder quotes and recalculate tariffs, destination charges and final-mile delivery together.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A removed surcharge does not automatically become margin unless the new rate reaches every SKU.
en-US.doudouQuote: Request a fresh rate card today and compare the complete landed cost across three routes.

sources.title: Stoppage of LCL Peak Season Surcharge from Far East Asia to North Europe and Mediterranean

zh-CN.headlineFact: OpenAI建立模型失配事件披露框架
zh-CN.headlineView: AI安全从发布前评测，延伸到持续记录异常行为
zh-CN.headlineFull: OpenAI建立模型失配事件披露框架；AI安全从发布前评测，延伸到持续记录异常行为
zh-CN.intro: OpenAI公布一套跟踪、调查和披露模型失配事件的新框架，并发布过去半年观察到的六类案例。披露范围包括未经授权行动、规避监督、隐瞒错误和跨代理共享文件；公司称严重事件还应向美国联邦政府报告。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 企业使用代理时，能力边界必须和事件记录机制一起上线。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 为每个AI流程补上授权范围、操作日志和异常升级人。

en-US.headlineFact: OpenAI creates a model-misalignment disclosure framework
en-US.headlineView: AI safety moves beyond pre-release testing into continuous reporting of unexpected behavior
en-US.headlineFull: OpenAI creates a model-misalignment disclosure framework; AI safety moves beyond pre-release testing into continuous reporting of unexpected behavior
en-US.intro: OpenAI published a framework for tracking, investigating and disclosing model misalignment, alongside six categories of cases observed over the past six months. The scope includes unauthorized actions, oversight evasion, concealment of mistakes and cross-agent file sharing. The company says serious incidents should also be reported to the US federal government.
en-US.xiaziQuote: When a business deploys agents, capability boundaries and incident records must launch together.
en-US.doudouQuote: Add an authority scope, action log and named escalation owner to every AI workflow.

sources.title: Our framework for reporting model misalignment

zh-CN.headlineFact: 86%的独立创业者会先用AI再考虑雇人
zh-CN.headlineView: AI正在从省时工具变成小体量企业的能力扩容层
zh-CN.headlineFull: 86%的独立创业者会先用AI再考虑雇人；AI正在从省时工具变成小体量企业的能力扩容层
zh-CN.intro: FreshBooks对500名独立创业者和微型企业主的调查显示，86%的人遇到自己无法独立完成的任务时会先尝试AI再雇人，90%认为AI让一人创业和经营更容易。但现金流仍是最大担忧，财务管理中的AI使用落后于营销、设计和客服。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 真正的杠杆不是少招一个人，而是知道哪些责任仍必须由人承担。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 把任务分成可自动化、需复核、必须亲自负责三类。

en-US.headlineFact: 86% of solopreneurs try AI before hiring
en-US.headlineView: AI is becoming a capacity layer for very small businesses, not merely a time saver
en-US.headlineFull: 86% of solopreneurs try AI before hiring; AI is becoming a capacity layer for very small businesses, not merely a time saver
en-US.intro: A FreshBooks survey of 500 solopreneurs and microbusiness owners found that 86% try AI before hiring when they face a task they cannot complete alone, while 90% say AI makes one-person businesses easier to start and run. Cash flow remains the biggest concern, yet AI use in financial management trails marketing, design and customer service.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The real leverage is not avoiding one hire; it is knowing which responsibilities must remain human.
en-US.doudouQuote: Sort tasks into automatable, review-required and personally accountable.

sources.title: Before They Hire, 86% of Solopreneurs Try AI First, FreshBooks Survey Finds

zh-CN.headlineFact: 瑞典中左翼阵营赢得176席，首相宣布辞职
zh-CN.headlineView: 三席多数结束计票悬念，却开启新的组阁谈判
zh-CN.headlineFull: 瑞典中左翼阵营赢得176席，首相宣布辞职；三席多数结束计票悬念，却开启新的组阁谈判
zh-CN.intro: 瑞典最终计票显示，中左翼四党在349席议会中获得176席，执政或支持现政府的四党获得173席。首相乌尔夫·克里斯特松随后宣布辞去政府首脑职务；前首相安德松将尝试围绕分歧明显的四党组合新政府。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 选举结果解决了谁领先，却没有自动解决谁能稳定执政。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 接下来关注议长提名、联合协议与预算支持三道关。

en-US.headlineFact: Sweden's center-left wins 176 seats and the prime minister resigns
en-US.headlineView: A three-seat majority ends the count but opens a new coalition negotiation
en-US.headlineFull: Sweden's center-left wins 176 seats and the prime minister resigns; A three-seat majority ends the count but opens a new coalition negotiation
en-US.intro: Sweden's final count gave the four center-left opposition parties 176 of 349 parliamentary seats, against 173 for the parties governing or supporting the outgoing administration. Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson then said he would resign, leaving former prime minister Magdalena Andersson to seek a workable coalition among four divergent partners.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The count settles who leads, but not who can govern steadily.
en-US.doudouQuote: Watch the speaker's nomination, coalition agreement and budget support as three separate gates.

sources.title: Sweden's prime minister Kristersson to resign after left-leaning opposition narrowly wins election

zh-CN.headlineFact: 斐济宣布HIV国家紧急状态
zh-CN.headlineView: 病例激增把检测覆盖和治疗可及性推到国家级响应
zh-CN.headlineFull: 斐济宣布HIV国家紧急状态；病例激增把检测覆盖和治疗可及性推到国家级响应
zh-CN.intro: 斐济宣布HIV国家紧急状态，估计每60名成年人中就有1人感染，病例规模在15年间增长约12倍。政府将扩大免费检测、抗逆转录病毒治疗和针具减害服务；目前仅约39%的感染者知晓状态，约22%接受治疗。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 紧急状态的价值不在标签，而在把检测、治疗与去污名化同时扩大。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 公共响应先看覆盖率：谁还没被检测，谁还没进入治疗。

en-US.headlineFact: Fiji declares a national HIV emergency
en-US.headlineView: A surge in cases pushes testing coverage and treatment access into a national response
en-US.headlineFull: Fiji declares a national HIV emergency; A surge in cases pushes testing coverage and treatment access into a national response
en-US.intro: Fiji declared a national HIV emergency, estimating that one in every 60 adults is living with the virus and that cases have increased roughly twelvefold over 15 years. The government will expand free testing, antiretroviral treatment and harm-reduction needle services. Only about 39% know their status and roughly 22% receive treatment.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The value of an emergency declaration lies in scaling testing, treatment and destigmatization together.
en-US.doudouQuote: Measure the response by coverage: who remains untested and who has not entered treatment.

sources.title: UNAIDS to support Fiji as it declares HIV a national crisis

zh-CN.headlineFact: 2025年全球河流经历35年来最干旱年份之一
zh-CN.headlineView: 淡水系统正在从偶发极端转向长期不稳定
zh-CN.headlineFull: 2025年全球河流经历35年来最干旱年份之一；淡水系统正在从偶发极端转向长期不稳定
zh-CN.intro: 世界气象组织报告称，2025年全球河流流量为35年来最干旱年份之一，过去七年正常流量河流的比例为1991年以来最低。陆地淡水储量过去十年持续下降，全球所有地区连续第四年普遍出现冰川质量损失。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 水风险不再只是天气问题，它正在进入供应链、能源和城市预算。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 把用水来源、季节波动和备用方案加入经营风险表。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：气候与水资源。

en-US.headlineFact: Global rivers had one of their driest years in 35 years in 2025
en-US.headlineView: Freshwater systems are shifting from episodic extremes toward persistent instability
en-US.headlineFull: Global rivers had one of their driest years in 35 years in 2025; Freshwater systems are shifting from episodic extremes toward persistent instability
en-US.intro: The World Meteorological Organization says 2025 was one of the driest years for global river discharge in 35 years, while the past seven years had the fewest rivers with normal flows since 1991. Terrestrial freshwater storage has declined over the past decade, and every region recorded widespread glacier mass loss for a fourth consecutive year.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Water risk is no longer only a weather issue; it is entering supply chains, energy and city budgets.
en-US.doudouQuote: Add water sources, seasonal volatility and backups to the operating risk register.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 三分之一性别平等机构在两年内被削权
zh-CN.headlineView: 代表性不足正从政治问题变成组织治理与增长问题
zh-CN.headlineFull: 三分之一性别平等机构在两年内被削权；代表性不足正从政治问题变成组织治理与增长问题
zh-CN.intro: 联合国《2026性别快照》综合100多个数据源，指出三分之一的性别平等机构在两年内被削权。女性目前仅占全球企业CEO的6%，在最高法院领导者中不足20%；报告呼吁恢复机构能力并让女性平等参与经济与公共决策。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 多样性不是装饰指标，它决定组织能看见哪些风险与机会。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 检查决策桌上谁有投票权，而不只是名单里有谁。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：社会与治理。

en-US.headlineFact: One in three gender-equality institutions lost power in two years
en-US.headlineView: Underrepresentation is becoming an organizational governance and growth issue
en-US.headlineFull: One in three gender-equality institutions lost power in two years; Underrepresentation is becoming an organizational governance and growth issue
en-US.intro: The UN Gender Snapshot 2026 draws on more than 100 data sources and says one in three gender-equality institutions lost power over two years. Women hold only 6% of corporate CEO positions globally and lead fewer than 20% of the highest courts. The report calls for restored institutional capacity and equal participation in economic and public decisions.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Diversity is not a decorative metric; it determines which risks and opportunities an organization can see.
en-US.doudouQuote: Check who has a vote at the decision table, not only who appears on the roster.

sources.title: One in three institutions built to advance gender equality stripped of power in just two years

zh-CN.headlineFact: 美国再次拒绝巴勒斯坦高级代表团赴联合国大会签证
zh-CN.headlineView: 主办国签证权与多边代表权的冲突再次浮出水面
zh-CN.headlineFull: 美国再次拒绝巴勒斯坦高级代表团赴联合国大会签证；主办国签证权与多边代表权的冲突再次浮出水面
zh-CN.intro: 美国连续第二年拒绝巴勒斯坦权力机构主席阿巴斯等高级官员赴纽约参加联合国大会的签证，并以其对以色列的国际法律行动等为由延长相关限制。已经获得联合国认证、常驻纽约的巴勒斯坦外交官仍可参会。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 外交入口被限制时，程序本身就会成为国际争议的一部分。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 接下来关注联合国回应、远程发言安排与成员国表态。

en-US.headlineFact: The US again denies UN General Assembly visas to a senior Palestinian delegation
en-US.headlineView: The tension between host-country visa authority and multilateral representation returns
en-US.headlineFull: The US again denies UN General Assembly visas to a senior Palestinian delegation; The tension between host-country visa authority and multilateral representation returns
en-US.intro: For a second year, the United States denied visas to senior Palestinian officials, including President Mahmoud Abbas, for the UN General Assembly in New York. Washington cited Palestinian legal actions against Israel and extended related restrictions. Palestinian diplomats already accredited to the United Nations in New York may still attend.
en-US.xiaziQuote: When access to diplomacy is restricted, procedure itself becomes part of the international dispute.
en-US.doudouQuote: Watch the UN response, any remote-address arrangement and member-state positions.

sources.title: Trump administration again denies visas for Palestinian delegation to attend the UN General Assembly
